patch_description: This design keeps the strongest observed regularizer—one globally shared parameter—but replaces fixed CZ entanglement with hierarchical parity-echo gadgets. Each CNOT–RY–CNOT sequence conjugates a local rotation into a trainable two-qubit parity interaction without adding another parameter. Three butterfly scales capture local, four-qubit, and cross-half correlations, while their echoed structure limits uncontrolled feature scrambling. A final shared RX layer converts the learned parity information into the measurement basis. The resulting circuit is an asymmetric, multiscale one-parameter quantum walk intended to improve hard-group separation while preserving parameter efficiency and small-sample generalization.
